exposure: Leiomyoma location (subserous, intramural, fundal, uterine corpus)
cohort: 136 pregnant women with uterine leiomyomas who underwent cesarean delivery at a center in Turkey between May 1, 2007, and April 30, 2014
finding: Cesarean myomectomy (CM) can be performed safely during cesarean delivery, and surgeons were more likely to remove corporal and subserous leiomyomas, while leiomyoma size did not seem to influence decision making.
mod_finding: The study investigated the safety and feasibility of cesarean myomectomy (CM) during cesarean delivery for pregnant women with leiomyomas.
